item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2025-5569 - ideacms ideacms Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component
item.description:
A vulnerability was found in IdeaCMS up to 1.7 and classified as critical. This issue affects the function Article/Goods of the file /api/v1.index.article/getList.html. The manipulation of the argument Field leads to sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.8 is able to address this issue. The patch is named 935aceb4c21338633de6d41e13332f7b9db4fa6a. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

Vendor: ideacms
Product: ideacms

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-119096 - Improper Authentication
item.description:
The Uncanny Toolkit for LearnDash plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in versions up to, and including, 3.8.2 via the `email` parameter of the `uo_login_action()` function. This is due to a parser-differential flaw in which the plugin's account-verification gate resolves the submitted `email` value using the raw, unsanitized string passed to `get_user_by()`, while the subsequent `wp_signon()` call relies on WordPress core's internal `sanitize_user()` to strip appended junk characters — causing the gate lookup to fail and be skipped entirely while the real account is still resolved and authenticated. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in to unverified or administrator-suspended accounts whose credentials they already possess, obtaining a valid `wordpress_logged_in` session cookie and defeating the plugin's account-approval and account-suspension controls. The nonce required to reach the handler is freely obtainable in the same request from the unauthenticated `ult-refresh-nonce` endpoint, making exploitation trivial for any attacker with network access to the site and knowledge of a target account's credentials.

Vendor: uncannyowl
Product: Uncanny Toolkit for LearnDash

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/uncanny-learndash-toolkit/vulnerability/wordpress-uncanny-toolkit-for-learndash-plugin-3-8-2-unauthenticated-authentication-bypass-vulnerability

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-103898 - Wpmet wp_social_login_and_register_social_counter Improper Authentication
item.description:
The Wp Social Login and Register Social Counter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.2. This is due to the social login REST callback registered at `/wp-json/wslu-social-login/type/{provider}/` with `permission_callback => __return_true` locating an existing WordPress account solely by the email string returned from the OAuth provider and calling `wp_set_auth_cookie()` without a password check, while the only verification guard — `!empty($getProfile->emailVerified)` in `inc/admin-create-user.php` — is a no-op for the bundled Hybridauth Facebook and Twitter adapters, both of which assign the raw email string rather than a boolean verified flag to `emailVerified`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to obtain a fully authenticated session as any existing WordPress user, including Administrators, whose registered email address can be presented through a configured Facebook or Twitter login on the target site. Exploitation requires only that the attacker control an OAuth account whose provider-returned email matches the target account's registered WordPress email address; no local credentials, nonce, or prior foothold is needed.

Vendor: Wpmet
Product: wp_social_login_and_register_social_counter

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/wp-social/vulnerability/wordpress-wp-social-login-and-register-social-counter-plugin-3-2-2-unauthenticated-authentication-bypass-vulnerability

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2015-20130 - netsweeper netsweeper Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation
item.description:
Netsweeper before 4.0.11 and 4.1.0 before 4.1.5 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in webadmin/reporter/view_server_log.php that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript by injecting malicious code through the log request parameter, which is reflected into the HTML response without output encoding. Attackers can craft a malicious URL and induce a user to request it, resulting in arbitrary JavaScript execution within the victim's browser session against the Netsweeper web administration interface. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

Vendor: netsweeper
Product: netsweeper

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-20130
  • https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/netsweeper-reflected-xss-via-view-server-log-php

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2025-11201 - lfprojects MLflow Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory
item.description:
MLflow Tracking Server Model Creation Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of MLflow Tracking Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of model file paths. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-26921.

Vendor: lfprojects
Product: MLflow

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-58115 - Missing Authentication for Critical Functionality
item.description:
A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced (6ES7647-0BA00-1YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4.1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed). Affected devices do not enforce authentication on the Node-RED HTTP interface, allowing unauthenticated access to programming nodes that are capable of executing system commands on the server. This could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create malicious flows through the HTTP interface in order to execute arbitrary code on the underlying server with maximum privileges.

Vendor: Siemens
Product: SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-53595 - freescout freescout Improper Handling of Case Sensitivity
item.description:
FreeScout is a free help desk and shared inbox built with PHP's Laravel framework. Prior to version 1.8.224, the public endpoint `POST /user-setup/{hash}/{invite_sent_at}` (`OpenController@userSetupSave`) selects the target account solely by its `invite_hash` column, then overwrites that account's email and password and logs in as it. No authentication, cookie, or prior session is required. After a user activates, FreeScout sets `invite_hash` to the empty string. On MySQL and MariaDB, `VARCHAR` equality ignores trailing spaces, so a single URL-encoded space (`%20`) matches the stored empty string and selects the lowest-id activated user. The expiry guard decrypts `invite_sent_at` with the target's password hash, but `Helper::decrypt` returns its raw input unchanged when decryption fails. A plaintext numeric value such as `9999999999` therefore passes the time-to-live check without any secret. The result is that an anonymous attacker sets the email and password of the lowest-id activated FreeScout account (a support agent, or an administrator if one was added by invitation) and authenticates as that account. Version 1.8.224 contains a fix.

Vendor: freescout
Product: freescout

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
